LG Electronics.why: its Eco Solution (ES) division sells chillers and CDUs for AI data centers; it won more than KRW 600 billion of AI data-center cooling projects in H1 2026 and its CDUs are qualified by NVIDIA
LG Electronics.evidence: In AI data centers the company builds on high-efficiency chillers and CDUs, targeting hyperscalers and colocation operators in North America; in H1 2026 it won projects worth more than KRW 600 billion now in production, and some CDU models obtained component quality certification from global big-tech companies including NVIDIA (LG Electronics half-year report, DART 08-14-2026)

players.product: AI data-center cooling: high-efficiency chillers and liquid-cooling coolant distribution units (CDUs, 600kW / 1MW / 2.6MW; 2.6MW model NVIDIA DSX Ready), CRAHs

quarterly_data.quarter: LG Electronics press release: LG Electronics' 2.6-Megawatt Coolant Distribution Unit (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: LG Electronics qualified its 2.6MW coolant distribution unit (CDU) as an NVIDIA DSX Ready CDU, meeting the applicable NVIDIA DSX reference design requirements for the DSX AI Factory Platform and listed on the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Marketplace; it follows the qualification of LG's 600kW and 1MW CDUs (LG has completed infrastructure qualification of the 600kW, 1MW and 2.6MW models; the 2.6MW model met the additional DSX Ready requirements and is categorized by NVIDIA as a Large-Scale solution). The release says demand is shifting from rack-level cooling to MW-class centralized, high-capacity CDUs as rack power density reaches hundreds of kilowatts. James Lee, president of the LG Eco Solution Company: NVIDIA's qualification reinforces LG's position as a first mover in next-generation liquid cooling, and LG will continue to supply AI data-center operators from its Chip-to-Chiller portfolio.
quarterly_data.figure: 2.6MW CDU qualified as NVIDIA DSX Ready (after 600kW and 1MW models)
